title: From a pet photo to a playable character in my desktop pet game
author: poookee
selftext:
I'm making Toplings!  A cute & cozy desktop app for windows and mac. 

Toplings can let you know when claude or codex is done working, remind you of calendar event, and help you focus (or simply pass the time when waiting for claude to finish working :) )  
  
A pet photo can become a companion you feed and play with on your desktop. You can also breed pets to make hybrids.

The AI generates the artwork and animation frames. The pipeline checks the frames, then the game's local simulation handles movement.

I'm showing the photo, the walk loop and the pet in-game together. The resemblance needs to hold up once it moves, not just in the first image.

[Toplings](https://toplings.com/) is free to start.   
  
Custom creations are paid because those AI generations cost me money.

Let me know what you think !

comments.author: ul90
comments.body: This is cute! A simple, but good idea. I'll try this later on my computer.
